BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has purchased 2,318,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program, with transactions occurring between August 17 and August 21, 2026. The average price paid per share during this period was 311.9 pence. Following these purchases, the company holds no shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,396,965,716, with a total of 1,396,965,716 voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 24 August 2026 24 August 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 17 August 2026 to 21 August 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").
